title.zh: 完整生成比较下的组织形成要求
title.en: Required organization under whole generative comparison

claim.zh: 在有限非空的合格接续中，若每种缺少某项组织关系的接续都有充分更好的合格构造，则所有未被击败的选择都包含该关系；这可支持建设或增强共同能力而不预定唯一承载。
claim.en: In a finite nonempty eligible range, if every continuation lacking an organizational relation has a strictly better eligible construction, every undefeated choice includes that relation. This can warrant building or strengthening shared capacity without fixing one carrier.

hypotheses.zh: G0、明确 J1–J4 与完整关系对应；不是从一元本体单独推出伦理。
hypotheses.en: G0, explicit J1–J4 and complete relational correspondence; ethics is not deduced from monism alone.

hypotheses.zh: 有限非空的合格范围、严格传递比较、每个缺失情形的实际改善见证；规范资格与基本分类仍须辩护。
hypotheses.en: A finite nonempty eligible range, irreflexive transitive comparison and actual improvement witnesses for every deficient case; normative eligibility and basic classifications require substantive warrant.

correspondence.zh: 同一支持历史形成连接、保留基础并承担休闲损失；甲乙是作用路径。具体模型的合格谓词只表示物理可行，不能独自认证现实权限。
correspondence.en: One support history forms links, retains a basis and bears an opportunity loss; the two carriers are routes. Concrete eligibility means physical feasibility only and does not certify real authority.

detail.zh: PracticalJudgment.finite_frontier 与 dominated_excluded 的输出经 formation_required_of_improvable_absence 接成 Required；规范解释继承公开 J 承诺。
detail.en: PracticalJudgment.finite_frontier and dominated_excluded feed formation_required_of_improvable_absence to produce Required; normative interpretation inherits the explicit J commitments.

detail.zh: 复用已完成的跨智能方向，推进组织形成的具体条件。
detail.en: Reuses the completed cross-intelligence direction to advance the conditions of organizational formation.

detail.zh: 过度建设实际耗尽生活基础；相同的建设报告不能判定基础。增加真实余量可修复本例的观察遗漏。
detail.en: Overbuilding actually depletes the living basis; identical construction reports fail to classify it. Faithful retained-amount information repairs this local omission.

limitations.zh: 尚未由一般生成结构充分推出陌生新生活的基本内容；无经验验证、无必然服从、无完整机构权限推导。已有公理与条件成果保持有效范围。
limitations.en: General generative structure has not supplied full basic-content correspondence for unfamiliar new living. No empirical validation, inevitable compliance or complete institutional authority derivation; existing axioms and conditional results retain their scope.

validation_scope.zh: 13项新 Lean 定理声明／29项声明审计；另重编30项继承定理／46项审计。含应用及定义对应，不是13个规范公理证明。作者反审；无独立 agent 验收。
validation_scope.en: 13 new Lean theorem declarations/29 declaration audits, with 30 inherited theorems/46 audits separately rebuilt. Includes applications and a definitional identity, not 13 normative-axiom proofs. Author counterreview; no independent-agent acceptance.

next_delta.zh: 在新形成且无法直接借用已知生活内容的情境中，落实既有后天基本条件原则的实质对应；复用组织命题，不重开一般责任或旧授权之墙。
next_delta.en: Establish substantive application of acquired-basic-condition principles where newly formed living contents cannot be borrowed from a known case; reuse organizational warrant rather than reopening general responsibility or the withdrawn authority wall.

history.zh: 2026-10-08：接续生成优先纠正，形成有范围的规范推论及新 Lean 组合；迁移该主张为唯一成果身份，历史来源与反例保留。
history.en: 2026-10-08: extends the generative-first correction with a scoped normative argument and new Lean composition; migrates this claim to one result identity while retaining historical sources and countercases.
